t: Forge Steel immersion heater spanner designed as a specialist tool for the efficient removal and installation of electric immersion heaters. Ideal for plumbers and heating engineers working on domestic and commercial water cylinders and tanks. The spanner features robust construction, with a cranked handle for ease of use and improved access in challenging, confined spaces. The 122mm ring head delivers a secure, non-slip grip on immersion heater elements, helping prevent damage to ensure reliable operation. The durable steel tool offers excellent strength and longevity for demanding trade applications.
